Title: Osney Bridge Oxford
Description: Towpath closure upstream of bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road.

Title: Marsh Lock Footbridge Henley
Description: Footbridge closed for safety. 3-mile diversion via Shiplake. Closure until 31 Jan 2026, may extend.

Title: Sandford Footbridge
Description: Unsafe tributary bridge closed. Diversion via NCN Route 5 cycle path alongside railway.

Title: Abingdon Weir Walkway
Description: Corrosion concerns. Reopened 30 Sept 2025. Closed intermittently during high flows/gate operation.

Title: Temple Footbridge Hurley
Description: Closed May 2023 for safety. Central section removed Nov 2025. Bridge requires complete replacement. Diversion via Bisham/Marlow until 2028 at earliest.

Title: Bridge 142 Runnymede Egham
Description: Cast iron pedestrian bridge damaged. Closed Feb 2024. Diversion via A308. Expected closure until 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock Works Runnymede
Description: Lock remains operational. Temporary diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds. Refurbishment work ongoing.

Title: Streatley-Goring Towpath
Description: Eroding towpath closure. 0.5-mile diversion inland via Manor Road. Unlikely to reopen until late 2026.

Title: Penton Hook Island
Description: Island closed to public. Diseased trees (ash dieback) pose safety risk. Thames Path unaffected.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge Faringdon
Description: Footbridge open to public. Thames Path passes north bank but does not cross.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal
Description: Left bank path blocked between River Brent bridge and Brentford Marina. Redevelopment ongoing. No official diversion.
